[Interior coordinates are positive]
  
  
  
  
  
  \textit{Source: half-formal.qmd, Lemma
  \texttt{\#lem-interior-positive}.}
  Let \(n\geq6\) with \(3\mid n\).  If \(c\) is a live all-rank wait,
  then \(c_k\geq1\) for every internal rank \(2\leq k\leq n-1\).
nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok
  Fix an internal \(k\) and suppose \(c_k=0\).  Let \(A\) and \(B\)
  be the total multiplicities strictly left and strictly right of \(k\).
  Since a run crossing the cut would contain rank \(k\), every complete
  decomposition after a draw separates into left and right pieces, with
  the unique pair on exactly one side.

  Drawing on the left shows
  \[
    (A,B)\equiv(1,0)\ \text{or}\ (2,2)\pmod3,
  \]
  and drawing on the right shows
  \[
    (A,B)\equiv(2,2)\ \text{or}\ (0,1)\pmod3.
  \]
  Hence \(A\equiv B\equiv2\pmod3\).  It follows that after every
  left-side draw the left piece is purely meldable.  If the left side had
  two ranks, drawing its first and second ranks would produce two meldable
  vectors whose rank sums differ by \(1\), contradicting
  Lemma~\ref{lem:meldable_rank_sum}.  Thus the left side has at most one
  rank.  The symmetric argument gives the same conclusion on the right.
  Therefore \(n\leq3\), contradicting \(n\geq6\).
nodes.lean_source:
theorem interior_positive {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (hdiv : 3 ∣ n)
    {c : Counts n} (hc : LiveWait c) {k : Fin n}
    (hk_left : 1 ≤ k.val) (hk_right : k.val + 1 < n) :
    1 ≤ c k := by
  by_contra hpos
  have hk0 : c k = 0 := by omega
  rcases hc with ⟨hbound, htotal, hcomplete⟩

  have left_draw_residue :
      ∀ x : Fin n, x.val < k.val →
        (Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 1 ∧
            Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 0) ∨
          (Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 2 ∧
            Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 2) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hcomplete x with ⟨p, hp, hpMeld⟩
    let w : Counts n := fun i => c i + basis x i
    let d : Counts n := removePair w p
    have hx_ne : k ≠ x := by
      intro h
      have : k.val = x.val := by simp [h]
      omega
    have hdk0 : d k = 0 := by
      dsimp [d, w]
      simp [removePair, basis, hk0, hx_ne]
    have hp_ne : p ≠ k := by
      intro hpk
      subst p
      have hwk : w k = 0 := by
        dsimp [w]
        simp [basis, hk0, hx_ne]
      have hpw : 2 ≤ w k := by simpa using hp
      rw [hwk] at hpw
      omega
    have hleftD := meldable_leftTotal_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hrightD := meldable_rightTotal_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hleftRemove :
        leftTotal k d + (if p.val < k.val then 2 else 0) = leftTotal k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [leftTotal] using
        filteredTotal_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) w p hp
    have hrightRemove :
        rightTotal k d + (if k.val < p.val then 2 else 0) = rightTotal k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [rightTotal] using
        filteredTotal_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) w p hp
    have hleftDraw : leftTotal k w = leftTotal k c + 1 := by
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [leftTotal, hx] using
        filteredTotal_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) c x
    have hrightDraw : rightTotal k w = rightTotal k c := by
      have hx_not_right : ¬ k.val < x.val := by omega
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [rightTotal, hx_not_right] using
        filteredTotal_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) c x
    have hp_side : p.val < k.val ∨ k.val < p.val := by
      have hne : p.val ≠ k.val := by
        intro hv
        exact hp_ne (Fin.ext hv)
      omega
    rcases hp_side with hp_left | hp_right
    · left
      have hleftW2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k w) 2 := by
        rw [← hleftRemove]
        have htmp : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k d + 2) 2 := by
          simpa using Nat.ModEq.add hleftD (Nat.ModEq.refl 2)
        simpa [hp_left] using htmp
      have hAplus : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c + 1) 2 := by
        simpa [hleftDraw] using hleftW2
      have hrightW0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k w) 0 := by
        rw [← hrightRemove]
        have hnot_right : ¬ k.val < p.val := by omega
        simpa [hnot_right] using hrightD
      have hB0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 0 := by
        simpa [hrightDraw] using hrightW0
      exact ⟨modEq_of_add_one_modEq_two hAplus, hB0⟩
    · right
      have hleftW0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k w) 0 := by
        rw [← hleftRemove]
        have hnot_left : ¬ p.val < k.val := by omega
        simpa [hnot_left] using hleftD
      have hAplus : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c + 1) 0 := by
        simpa [hleftDraw] using hleftW0
      have hrightW2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k w) 2 := by
        rw [← hrightRemove]
        have htmp : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k d + 2) 2 := by
          simpa using Nat.ModEq.add hrightD (Nat.ModEq.refl 2)
        simpa [hp_right] using htmp
      have hB2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 2 := by
        simpa [hrightDraw] using hrightW2
      exact ⟨modEq_of_add_one_modEq_zero hAplus, hB2⟩

  have right_draw_residue :
      ∀ x : Fin n, k.val < x.val →
        (Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 2 ∧
            Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 2) ∨
          (Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 0 ∧
            Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 1) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hcomplete x with ⟨p, hp, hpMeld⟩
    let w : Counts n := fun i => c i + basis x i
    let d : Counts n := removePair w p
    have hx_ne : k ≠ x := by
      intro h
      have : k.val = x.val := by simp [h]
      omega
    have hdk0 : d k = 0 := by
      dsimp [d, w]
      simp [removePair, basis, hk0, hx_ne]
    have hp_ne : p ≠ k := by
      intro hpk
      subst p
      have hwk : w k = 0 := by
        dsimp [w]
        simp [basis, hk0, hx_ne]
      have hpw : 2 ≤ w k := by simpa using hp
      rw [hwk] at hpw
      omega
    have hleftD := meldable_leftTotal_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hrightD := meldable_rightTotal_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hleftRemove :
        leftTotal k d + (if p.val < k.val then 2 else 0) = leftTotal k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [leftTotal] using
        filteredTotal_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) w p hp
    have hrightRemove :
        rightTotal k d + (if k.val < p.val then 2 else 0) = rightTotal k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [rightTotal] using
        filteredTotal_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) w p hp
    have hleftDraw : leftTotal k w = leftTotal k c := by
      have hx_not_left : ¬ x.val < k.val := by omega
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [leftTotal, hx_not_left] using
        filteredTotal_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) c x
    have hrightDraw : rightTotal k w = rightTotal k c + 1 := by
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [rightTotal, hx] using
        filteredTotal_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) c x
    have hp_side : p.val < k.val ∨ k.val < p.val := by
      have hne : p.val ≠ k.val := by
        intro hv
        exact hp_ne (Fin.ext hv)
      omega
    rcases hp_side with hp_left | hp_right
    · left
      have hleftW2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k w) 2 := by
        rw [← hleftRemove]
        have htmp : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k d + 2) 2 := by
          simpa using Nat.ModEq.add hleftD (Nat.ModEq.refl 2)
        simpa [hp_left] using htmp
      have hA2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 2 := by
        simpa [hleftDraw] using hleftW2
      have hrightW0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k w) 0 := by
        rw [← hrightRemove]
        have hnot_right : ¬ k.val < p.val := by omega
        simpa [hnot_right] using hrightD
      have hBplus : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c + 1) 0 := by
        simpa [hrightDraw] using hrightW0
      exact ⟨hA2, modEq_of_add_one_modEq_zero hBplus⟩
    · right
      have hleftW0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k w) 0 := by
        rw [← hleftRemove]
        have hnot_left : ¬ p.val < k.val := by omega
        simpa [hnot_left] using hleftD
      have hA0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 0 := by
        simpa [hleftDraw] using hleftW0
      have hrightW2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k w) 2 := by
        rw [← hrightRemove]
        have htmp : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k d + 2) 2 := by
          simpa using Nat.ModEq.add hrightD (Nat.ModEq.refl 2)
        simpa [hp_right] using htmp
      have hBplus : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c + 1) 2 := by
        simpa [hrightDraw] using hrightW2
      exact ⟨hA0, modEq_of_add_one_modEq_two hBplus⟩

  let xLeft : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hxLeft : xLeft.val < k.val := by
    dsimp [xLeft]
    omega
  let xRight : Fin n := ⟨k.val + 1, hk_right⟩
  have hxRight : k.val < xRight.val := by
    dsimp [xRight]
    omega
  have hLeftResidue := left_draw_residue xLeft hxLeft
  have hRightResidue := right_draw_residue xRight hxRight
  have hAB :
      Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c) 2 ∧
        Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c) 2 := by
    rcases hLeftResidue with hL | hL
    · rcases hRightResidue with hR | hR
      · exact hR
      · exfalso
        have hbad : Nat.ModEq 3 1 0 := hL.1.symm.trans hR.1
        norm_num at hbad
    · exact hL

  have left_draw_rank_mod :
      ∀ x : Fin n, x.val < k.val →
        Nat.ModEq 3 (leftRankSum k c + (x.val + 1)) 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hcomplete x with ⟨p, hp, hpMeld⟩
    let w : Counts n := fun i => c i + basis x i
    let d : Counts n := removePair w p
    have hx_ne : k ≠ x := by
      intro h
      have : k.val = x.val := by simp [h]
      omega
    have hdk0 : d k = 0 := by
      dsimp [d, w]
      simp [removePair, basis, hk0, hx_ne]
    have hp_ne : p ≠ k := by
      intro hpk
      subst p
      have hwk : w k = 0 := by
        dsimp [w]
        simp [basis, hk0, hx_ne]
      have hpw : 2 ≤ w k := by simpa using hp
      rw [hwk] at hpw
      omega
    have hleftD := meldable_leftTotal_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hleftRankD := meldable_leftRank_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hleftRemove :
        leftTotal k d + (if p.val < k.val then 2 else 0) = leftTotal k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [leftTotal] using
        filteredTotal_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) w p hp
    have hleftDraw : leftTotal k w = leftTotal k c + 1 := by
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [leftTotal, hx] using
        filteredTotal_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) c x
    have hp_not_left : ¬ p.val < k.val := by
      intro hp_left
      have hleftW2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k w) 2 := by
        rw [← hleftRemove]
        have htmp : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k d + 2) 2 := by
          simpa using Nat.ModEq.add hleftD (Nat.ModEq.refl 2)
        simpa [hp_left] using htmp
      have hAplus : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftTotal k c + 1) 2 := by
        simpa [hleftDraw] using hleftW2
      have hA1 := modEq_of_add_one_modEq_two hAplus
      have hbad : Nat.ModEq 3 1 2 := hA1.symm.trans hAB.1
      norm_num at hbad
    have hleftRankRemove :
        leftRankSum k d +
            (if p.val < k.val then (p.val + 1) * 2 else 0) =
          leftRankSum k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [leftRankSum] using
        filteredRank_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) w p hp
    have hleftRankDraw :
        leftRankSum k w = leftRankSum k c + (x.val + 1) := by
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [leftRankSum, hx] using
        filteredRank_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k.val) c x
    have hleftW0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftRankSum k w) 0 := by
      rw [← hleftRankRemove]
      simpa [hp_not_left] using hleftRankD
    simpa [hleftRankDraw] using hleftW0

  have right_draw_rank_mod :
      ∀ x : Fin n, k.val < x.val →
        Nat.ModEq 3 (rightRankSum k c + (x.val + 1)) 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hcomplete x with ⟨p, hp, hpMeld⟩
    let w : Counts n := fun i => c i + basis x i
    let d : Counts n := removePair w p
    have hx_ne : k ≠ x := by
      intro h
      have : k.val = x.val := by simp [h]
      omega
    have hdk0 : d k = 0 := by
      dsimp [d, w]
      simp [removePair, basis, hk0, hx_ne]
    have hp_ne : p ≠ k := by
      intro hpk
      subst p
      have hwk : w k = 0 := by
        dsimp [w]
        simp [basis, hk0, hx_ne]
      have hpw : 2 ≤ w k := by simpa using hp
      rw [hwk] at hpw
      omega
    have hrightD := meldable_rightTotal_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hrightRankD := meldable_rightRank_mod_of_zero d k hpMeld hdk0
    have hrightRemove :
        rightTotal k d + (if k.val < p.val then 2 else 0) = rightTotal k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [rightTotal] using
        filteredTotal_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) w p hp
    have hrightDraw : rightTotal k w = rightTotal k c + 1 := by
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [rightTotal, hx] using
        filteredTotal_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) c x
    have hp_not_right : ¬ k.val < p.val := by
      intro hp_right
      have hrightW2 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k w) 2 := by
        rw [← hrightRemove]
        have htmp : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k d + 2) 2 := by
          simpa using Nat.ModEq.add hrightD (Nat.ModEq.refl 2)
        simpa [hp_right] using htmp
      have hBplus : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightTotal k c + 1) 2 := by
        simpa [hrightDraw] using hrightW2
      have hB1 := modEq_of_add_one_modEq_two hBplus
      have hbad : Nat.ModEq 3 1 2 := hB1.symm.trans hAB.2
      norm_num at hbad
    have hrightRankRemove :
        rightRankSum k d +
            (if k.val < p.val then (p.val + 1) * 2 else 0) =
          rightRankSum k w := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [rightRankSum] using
        filteredRank_removePair_add_pair (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) w p hp
    have hrightRankDraw :
        rightRankSum k w = rightRankSum k c + (x.val + 1) := by
      dsimp [w]
      simpa [rightRankSum, hx] using
        filteredRank_add_basis (fun i : Fin n => k.val < i.val) c x
    have hrightW0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightRankSum k w) 0 := by
      rw [← hrightRankRemove]
      simpa [hp_not_right] using hrightRankD
    simpa [hrightRankDraw] using hrightW0

  have hk_le_one : k.val ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hknot
    have hk_two : 2 ≤ k.val := by omega
    let y0 : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    let y1 : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
    have hy0 : y0.val < k.val := by
      dsimp [y0]
      omega
    have hy1 : y1.val < k.val := by
      dsimp [y1]
      omega
    have h0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftRankSum k c + 1) 0 := by
      simpa [y0] using left_draw_rank_mod y0 hy0
    have h1 : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftRankSum k c + 2) 0 := by
      simpa [y1] using left_draw_rank_mod y1 hy1
    have hsame : Nat.ModEq 3 (leftRankSum k c + 1) (leftRankSum k c + 2) :=
      h0.trans h1.symm
    have hbad : Nat.ModEq 3 1 2 :=
      Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel (Nat.ModEq.refl (leftRankSum k c)) hsame
    norm_num at hbad

  have hn_le_k_two : n ≤ k.val + 2 := by
    by_contra hnnot
    have hk_two_right : k.val + 2 < n := by omega
    let z0 : Fin n := ⟨k.val + 1, by omega⟩
    let z1 : Fin n := ⟨k.val + 2, hk_two_right⟩
    have hz0 : k.val < z0.val := by
      dsimp [z0]
      omega
    have hz1 : k.val < z1.val := by
      dsimp [z1]
      omega
    have h0 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightRankSum k c + (k.val + 2)) 0 := by
      simpa [z0, add_assoc] using right_draw_rank_mod z0 hz0
    have h1 : Nat.ModEq 3 (rightRankSum k c + (k.val + 3)) 0 := by
      simpa [z1, add_assoc] using right_draw_rank_mod z1 hz1
    have hsame :
        Nat.ModEq 3
          (rightRankSum k c + (k.val + 2))
          (rightRankSum k c + (k.val + 3)) :=
      h0.trans h1.symm
    have hdiff : Nat.ModEq 3 (k.val + 2) (k.val + 3) :=
      Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel (Nat.ModEq.refl (rightRankSum k c)) hsame
    have hbad : Nat.ModEq 3 2 3 :=
      Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel (Nat.ModEq.refl k.val) hdiff
    norm_num at hbad

  omega

[Option fold over appended lists]
  
  
  For a fold in the \(\mathrm{Option}\) monad, folding over an appended
  list is the same as folding over the prefix and, if that succeeds,
  continuing the fold over the suffix from the produced state.

  Induct on the prefix.  The empty prefix is immediate.  For a nonempty
  prefix, expose the first monadic step; if it fails both sides fail, and
  if it succeeds the induction hypothesis applies to the tail.

private lemma foldlM_append_option {α σ : Type*} (f : σ → α → Option σ)
    (l₁ l₂ : List α) (s : σ) :
    (l₁ ++ l₂).foldlM f s =
      (l₁.foldlM f s >>= fun s' => l₂.foldlM f s') := by
  induction l₁ generalizing s with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons a as ih =>
      simp [List.foldlM]
      cases f s a <;> simp

[Deleting a successful singleton scan block]
  
  
  
  If a scan of \(\mathit{pref}\,[1,1,1]\,\mathit{suff}\) from state
  \(\sigma\) succeeds with final state \(\tau\), then the scan of
  \(\mathit{pref}\,\mathit{suff}\) from \(\sigma\) also succeeds with
  final state \(\tau\).
nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok
  Split the successful scan at the prefix using
  Lemma~\ref{lem:foldlM_append_option}.  The prefix cannot have failed.
  Inspect the three scans of the entries \(1,1,1\); since the full scan
  succeeds, all three steps succeed.  They form the length-three scan of
  the constant-one vector, so Lemma~\ref{lem:scan_three_ones} says that
  the state after the block is the same as the state before it.  The
  suffix therefore starts from the same state with or without the block.

private lemma scan_delete_three_ones_block
    (pref suff : List ℕ) (σ τ : ScanState)
    (h : (pref ++ [1, 1, 1] ++ suff).foldlM scanStep σ = some τ) :
    (pref ++ suff).foldlM scanStep σ = some τ := by
  rw [foldlM_append_option] at h ⊢
  cases hp : pref.foldlM scanStep σ with
  | none =>
      simp [hp] at h
  | some σp =>
      simp [hp] at h ⊢
      cases h1 : scanStep σp 1 with
      | none =>
          simp [h1] at h
      | some σ1 =>
          cases h2 : scanStep σ1 1 with
          | none =>
              simp [h1, h2] at h
          | some σ2 =>
              cases h3 : scanStep σ2 1 with
              | none =>
                  simp [h1, h2, h3] at h
              | some σ3 =>
                  simp [h1, h2, h3] at h
                  have hscan : scan (fun _ : Fin 3 => 1) σp = some σ3 := by
                    simp [scan, List.ofFn_succ, h1, h2, h3]
                  have hsame : σ3 = σp := scan_three_ones σp σ3 hscan
                  subst σ3
                  exact h

  list underlying \(d\) by taking the first \(j\) entries and appending

nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok

  embedded unchanged by \(\iota_j\), while an index at or after \(j\) is

nodes.lean_source:
private lemma ofFn_deleteThree_eq_take_drop {n : ℕ} (d : Counts n) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j + 3 ≤ n) :

      (List.ofFn d).take j ++ (List.ofFn d).drop (j + 3) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem?
  intro i
  simp only [List.getElem?_ofFn, List.getElem?_append, List.getElem?_take,
    List.getElem?_drop, List.length_take, List.length_ofFn]
  by_cases hi : i < n - 3
  · simp [hi]
    by_cases hij : i < j
    · have hin : i < n := by omega
      simp [hij, hin, deleteThree, deleteIndex]
    · have hidx : j + 3 + (i - min j n) = i + 3 := by omega
      have hi3 : i + 3 < n := by omega
      simp [hi3, hidx, deleteThree, deleteIndex, hij]
  · simp [hi]
    by_cases ht : i < min j n
    · have : i < n - 3 := by omega
      contradiction
    · have hidxge : ¬ j + 3 + (i - min j n) < n := by omega
      simp [hidxge]
      omega

[Splitting off three singleton entries]
  
  
  
  If the three coordinates \(j,j+1,j+2\) of \(d\) are all \(1\), then
  the list underlying \(d\) is its prefix before \(j\), followed by
  \([1,1,1]\), followed by its suffix after \(j+2\).
nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok
  Start from the identity \(l=\operatorname{take}_j(l)\) followed by
  \(\operatorname{drop}_j(l)\).  Repeatedly expose the first element of
  the remaining drop at positions \(j,j+1,j+2\), and use the singleton
  hypotheses to identify those exposed entries as \(1\).
nodes.lean_source:
private lemma ofFn_eq_take_ones_drop {n : ℕ} (d : Counts n) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j + 3 ≤ n)
    (hsingle : ∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 → d r = 1) :
    List.ofFn d =
      (List.ofFn d).take j ++ [1, 1, 1] ++ (List.ofFn d).drop (j + 3) := by
  let l := List.ofFn d
  have hlen : l.length = n := by simp [l]
  have hj0 : j < l.length := by omega
  have hj1 : j + 1 < l.length := by omega
  have hj2 : j + 2 < l.length := by omega
  have h0 : l[j] = 1 := by
    dsimp [l]
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
    convert hsingle (⟨j, by omega⟩ : Fin n) (by simp)
      (by change j < j + 3; omega) using 1
  have h1 : l[j + 1] = 1 := by
    dsimp [l]
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
    convert hsingle (⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin n) (by simp)
      (by change j + 1 < j + 3; omega) using 1
  have h2 : l[j + 2] = 1 := by
    dsimp [l]
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
    convert hsingle (⟨j + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin n) (by simp)
      (by change j + 2 < j + 3; omega) using 1
  calc
    List.ofFn d = l := rfl
    _ = l.take j ++ l.drop j := (List.take_append_drop j l).symm
    _ = l.take j ++ (l[j] :: l.drop (j + 1)) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj0]
    _ = l.take j ++ (1 :: l.drop (j + 1)) := by
      rw [h0]
    _ = l.take j ++ (1 :: l[j + 1] :: l.drop (j + 2)) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj1]
    _ = l.take j ++ (1 :: 1 :: l.drop (j + 2)) := by
      rw [h1]
    _ = l.take j ++ (1 :: 1 :: l[j + 2] :: l.drop (j + 3)) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hj2]
    _ = l.take j ++ (1 :: 1 :: 1 :: l.drop (j + 3)) := by
      rw [h2]
    _ = (List.ofFn d).take j ++ [1, 1, 1] ++ (List.ofFn d).drop (j + 3) := by
      simp [l]

private lemma total_eq_list_sum {n : ℕ} (c : Counts n) :
    total c = (List.ofFn c).sum := by

  | zero =>

  | succ n ih =>
      rw [total, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      have htail := ih (fun i : Fin n => c i.succ)

private lemma deleteIndex_injective {n : ℕ} (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 3 ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (deleteIndex j hj) := by
  intro a b h

  simp [deleteIndex] at h
  by_cases ha : a.val < j <;>
    by_cases hb : b.val < j <;>
      simp [ha, hb] at h <;> omega

private lemma deleteIndex_not_deleted {n : ℕ} (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 3 ≤ n)

  · simp [hr]
  · simp [hr]

private lemma deleteIndex_preimage_of_not_deleted {n : ℕ} (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j + 3 ≤ n) (p : Fin n)
    (hnot : ¬ (j ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < j + 3)) :
    ∃ p' : Fin (n - 3), deleteIndex j hj p' = p := by
  by_cases hpb : p.val < j
  · refine ⟨⟨p.val, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [deleteIndex, hpb]
  · have hge : j + 3 ≤ p.val := by
      by_contra hlt
      exact hnot ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨⟨p.val - 3, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    have hnotlt : ¬ p.val - 3 < j := by omega
    simp [deleteIndex, hnotlt]
    omega

private lemma basis_deleteIndex {n : ℕ} (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 3 ≤ n)
    (x r : Fin (n - 3)) :
    basis (deleteIndex j hj x) (deleteIndex j hj r) = basis x r := by
  by_cases h : r = x
  · subst r
    simp [basis]
  · have hne : deleteIndex j hj r ≠ deleteIndex j hj x := by
      intro heq
      exact h (deleteIndex_injective j hj heq)
    simp [basis, h, hne]

private lemma deleteThree_removePair_add_basis {n : ℕ} (c : Counts n)

[Deleting three singletons preserves meldability]
  
  
  
  
  
  \textit{Source: half-formal.qmd, proof of Lemma
  \texttt{\#lem-delete}.}
  If \(d\) is meldable and its three coordinates beginning at \(j\) are
  all \(1\), then \(\operatorname{del}_j(d)\) is meldable.
nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok
  By Theorem~\ref{thm:meldable_iff_scan}, the scan of \(d\) succeeds from
  zero to zero.  Let \(\sigma\) be the state just before the three
  singleton coordinates.  Lemma~\ref{lem:scan_three_ones} says that the
  state just after them is again \(\sigma\).  The shortened scan has the
  same prefix state and then reads exactly the same suffix, so it also
  succeeds and finishes at zero.  Apply
  Theorem~\ref{thm:meldable_iff_scan} again.
nodes.lean_source:
lemma delete_three_meldable {n : ℕ} (d : Counts n) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j + 3 ≤ n) (hd : Meldable d)
    (hsingle : ∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 → d r = 1) :
    Meldable (deleteThree d j hj) := by
  apply (meldable_iff_scanAccepts (deleteThree d j hj)).mpr
  have hscan : scan d ((0, 0) : ScanState) = some ((0, 0) : ScanState) :=
    (meldable_iff_scanAccepts d).mp hd
  have hdel := ofFn_deleteThree_eq_take_drop d j hj
  have hfull := ofFn_eq_take_ones_drop d j hj hsingle
  dsimp [ScanAccepts]
  change (List.ofFn (fun r => deleteThree d j hj r)).foldlM scanStep
      ((0, 0) : ScanState) = some ((0, 0) : ScanState)
  rw [hdel]
  apply scan_delete_three_ones_block ((List.ofFn d).take j)
    ((List.ofFn d).drop (j + 3)) ((0, 0) : ScanState) ((0, 0) : ScanState)
  rw [← hfull]
  change scan d ((0, 0) : ScanState) = some ((0, 0) : ScanState)
  exact hscan

[Deletion preserves a live all-rank wait]
  
  
  
  
  
  \textit{Source: half-formal.qmd, Lemma \texttt{\#lem-delete}.}
  Let \(n\geq9\), \(3\mid n\), and let \(c\) be a live all-rank wait.
  If the three internal coordinates beginning at \(j\) all have
  multiplicity \(1\), then \(\operatorname{del}_j(c)\) is a live
  all-rank wait of length \(n-3\).
nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok
  The deleted coordinates contain exactly three tiles, so the shortened
  total is \((n+4)-3=(n-3)+4\).  Every retained coordinate still has
  multiplicity at most \(3\).

  Fix a new draw \(x'\), and let \(x=\iota_j(x')\).  Choose a complete
  decomposition of \(c+e_x\), with pair at \(p\) and meldable remainder
  \(d\).  Since \(x\) is retained, the three deleted coordinates still
  have multiplicity \(1\), so the pair cannot lie among them.  Hence
  \(p=\iota_j(p')\) for a unique retained \(p'\).  Coordinatewise
  calculation gives
  \[
    \operatorname{del}_j(d)
      =\operatorname{del}_j(c)+e_{x'}-2e_{p'}.
  \]
  The left side is meldable by
  Lemma~\ref{lem:delete_three_meldable}.  Thus every draw completes the
  shortened hand, proving the live-wait condition.
nodes.lean_source:
theorem delete_three_live_wait {n : ℕ} (hn : 9 ≤ n) (hdiv : 3 ∣ n)
    (c : Counts n) (hc : LiveWait c) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_left : 1 ≤ j) (hj_right : j + 3 < n)
    (hsingle : ∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 → c r = 1) :
    LiveWait (deleteThree c j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_right)) := by
  let hj : j + 3 ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt hj_right
  have _hleft : 1 ≤ j := hj_left
  change LiveWait (deleteThree c j hj)
  rcases hc with ⟨hbound, htotal, hcomplete⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    exact hbound (deleteIndex j hj r)
  · have hdelSum :
        total (deleteThree c j hj) =
          ((List.ofFn c).take j).sum + ((List.ofFn c).drop (j + 3)).sum := by
      rw [total_eq_list_sum (deleteThree c j hj)]
      change (List.ofFn (fun r => deleteThree c j hj r)).sum =
        ((List.ofFn c).take j).sum + ((List.ofFn c).drop (j + 3)).sum
      rw [ofFn_deleteThree_eq_take_drop c j hj]
      simp [List.sum_append]
    have hfullSum :
        (List.ofFn c).sum =
          ((List.ofFn c).take j).sum + 3 + ((List.ofFn c).drop (j + 3)).sum := by
      have hfull := congrArg List.sum (ofFn_eq_take_ones_drop c j hj hsingle)
      simp [List.sum_append] at hfull
      omega
    have hcSum : (List.ofFn c).sum = n + 4 := by
      rw [← total_eq_list_sum c]
      exact htotal
    rw [hdelSum]
    omega
  · intro x'
    let x : Fin n := deleteIndex j hj x'
    rcases hcomplete x with ⟨p, hp, hpMeld⟩
    have hx_not_deleted :
        ¬ (j ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < j + 3) := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact deleteIndex_not_deleted j hj x'
    have hp_not_deleted :
        ¬ (j ≤ p.val ∧ p.val < j + 3) := by
      intro hpdel
      have hx_ne : p ≠ x := by
        intro hpx
        subst p
        exact hx_not_deleted hpdel
      have hpone : (fun i : Fin n => c i + basis x i) p = 1 := by
        have hcp : c p = 1 := hsingle p hpdel.1 hpdel.2
        simp [basis, hx_ne, hcp]
      rw [hpone] at hp
      omega
    rcases deleteIndex_preimage_of_not_deleted j hj p hp_not_deleted with
      ⟨p', hpidx⟩
    refine ⟨p', ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hp_at_idx :
          2 ≤ c (deleteIndex j hj p') + basis x (deleteIndex j hj p') := by
        simpa [hpidx] using hp
      simpa [deleteThree, x, basis_deleteIndex] using hp_at_idx
    · have hpMeldIdx :
          Meldable
            (removePair
              (fun i : Fin n => c i + basis (deleteIndex j hj x') i)
              (deleteIndex j hj p')) := by
        simpa [x, hpidx] using hpMeld
      have hsingleDorig :
          ∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 →
            removePair (fun i : Fin n => c i + basis x i) p r = 1 := by
        intro r hrL hrR
        have hx_ne : r ≠ x := by
          intro hrx
          subst r
          exact hx_not_deleted ⟨hrL, hrR⟩
        have hp_ne : r ≠ p := by
          intro hrp
          subst r
          exact hp_not_deleted ⟨hrL, hrR⟩
        simp [removePair, basis, hx_ne, hp_ne, hsingle r hrL hrR]
      have hsingleD :
          ∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 →
            removePair
              (fun i : Fin n => c i + basis (deleteIndex j hj x') i)
              (deleteIndex j hj p') r = 1 := by
        simpa [x, hpidx] using hsingleDorig
      have hdelMeld :
          Meldable
            (deleteThree
              (removePair
                (fun i : Fin n => c i + basis (deleteIndex j hj x') i)
                (deleteIndex j hj p')) j hj) :=
        delete_three_meldable
          (removePair
            (fun i : Fin n => c i + basis (deleteIndex j hj x') i)
            (deleteIndex j hj p')) j hj hpMeldIdx hsingleD
      rw [deleteThree_removePair_add_basis c j hj x' p'] at hdelMeld
      exact hdelMeld

\leanok

nodes.lean_source:
theorem delete_three_standard_iff {n : ℕ} (c : Counts n) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_left : 1 ≤ j) (hj_right : j + 3 < n)
    (hsingle : ∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 → c r = 1) :
    c = standard n ↔
      deleteThree c j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_right) = standard (n - 3) := by
  constructor
  · intro hc
    subst c
    funext r
    simp only [deleteThree, deleteIndex, standard]
    by_cases hr : r.val < j
    · simp [hr]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · simp [hr]
      split_ifs <;> omega
  · intro hc
    funext i
    by_cases hbefore : i.val < j
    · let r : Fin (n - 3) := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
      have hidx : deleteIndex j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_right) r = i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [deleteIndex, r, hbefore]
      have hr := congrFun hc r
      rw [deleteThree, hidx] at hr
      calc
        c i = standard (n - 3) r := hr
        _ = standard n i := by
          simp [standard, r]
          split_ifs <;> omega
    · by_cases hdeleted : i.val < j + 3
      · have hci : c i = 1 := hsingle i (by omega) hdeleted
        rw [hci]
        simp only [standard]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      · let r : Fin (n - 3) := ⟨i.val - 3, by omega⟩
        have hr_ge : j ≤ r.val := by
          simp [r]
          omega
        have hidx : deleteIndex j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_right) r = i := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp [deleteIndex, r, not_lt_of_ge hr_ge]
          omega
        have hr := congrFun hc r
        rw [deleteThree, hidx] at hr
        calc
          c i = standard (n - 3) r := hr
          _ = standard n i := by
            simp [standard, r]
            split_ifs <;> omega

  \((c_i-1)+1=c_i\) there.  Therefore
  \[
    \sum_{\text{internal }i}(c_i-1)+(n-2)
      =\sum_{\text{internal }i}c_i.
  \]
  The internal sum is bounded by the total tile count, which is \(n+4\) for a
  live all-rank wait.  Subtracting the \(n-2\) internal coordinates gives the
  bound \(6\).

private lemma internal_excess_le_six {n : ℕ} {c : Counts n}
    (hn6 : 6 ≤ n) (hdiv : 3 ∣ n) (hc : LiveWait c) :
    (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) ≤ 6 := by
  have htotal : total c = n + 4 := hc.2.1
  have hpos :
      ∀ i ∈ internalIndices n, 1 ≤ c i := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' := (mem_internalIndices.mp hi)
    exact interior_positive hn6 hdiv hc hi'.1 hi'.2
  have hadd :
      (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) + (internalIndices n).card =
        (internalIndices n).sum fun i => c i := by
    calc
      (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) + (internalIndices n).card
          = (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) +
              (internalIndices n).sum (fun _ => 1) := by
                rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
      _ = (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => (c i - 1) + 1) := by
                rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = (internalIndices n).sum fun i => c i := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro i hi
                exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (hpos i hi)
  have hsum_le_total :
      (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i) ≤ total c := by
    simpa [total] using
      (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (s := internalIndices n) (t := Finset.univ) (f := c)
        (by intro i hi; simp)
        (by intro i hi hnot; exact Nat.zero_le (c i)))
  have hcard := card_internalIndices n
  have hmain :
      (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) + (n - 2) ≤ n + 4 := by
    rw [← hcard, hadd]
    simpa [htotal] using hsum_le_total
  omega

private lemma exception_card_le_internal_excess {n : ℕ} {c : Counts n}
    (hpos : ∀ i ∈ internalIndices n, 1 ≤ c i) :
    ((internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)).card ≤
      (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) := by
  let E := (internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)
  have hEsubset : E ⊆ internalIndices n := by
    intro i hi
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
  calc
    E.card = E.sum (fun _ => 1) := by
      rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
    _ ≤ E.sum (fun i => c i - 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hi_internal : i ∈ internalIndices n := hEsubset hi
      have hi_ne : c i ≠ 1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      have hi_pos : 1 ≤ c i := hpos i hi_internal
      omega
    _ ≤ (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hEsubset
        (by intro i hi hnot; exact Nat.zero_le (c i - 1))

private lemma seven_le_exception_card_of_no_three {n : ℕ} {c : Counts n}
    (hn24 : 24 ≤ n)
    (hno_three :
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 3 < n →
        ¬ (∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 → c r = 1)) :
    7 ≤ ((internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)).card := by
  classical
  let E := (internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)
  have hblock :
      ∀ t : Fin 7,
        ∃ r : Fin n,
          (1 + 3 * t.val ≤ r.val ∧
            r.val < 1 + 3 * t.val + 3 ∧ c r ≠ 1) := by
    intro t
    let j := 1 + 3 * t.val
    have hj_left : 1 ≤ j := by omega
    have hj_right : j + 3 < n := by
      have ht : t.val < 7 := t.isLt
      omega
    by_contra hnone
    apply hno_three j hj_left hj_right
    intro r hrL hrR
    by_contra hr_ne
    exact hnone ⟨r, hrL, hrR, hr_ne⟩
  let pick : Fin 7 → Fin n := fun t => Classical.choose (hblock t)
  have pick_spec :
      ∀ t : Fin 7,
        1 + 3 * t.val ≤ (pick t).val ∧
          (pick t).val < 1 + 3 * t.val + 3 ∧ c (pick t) ≠ 1 := by
    intro t
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hblock t)
  have hpick_mem : ∀ t : Fin 7, pick t ∈ E := by
    intro t
    have ht := pick_spec t
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    constructor
    · apply mem_internalIndices.mpr
      constructor <;> omega
    · exact ht.2.2
  have hpick_inj : Function.Injective pick := by
    intro t u htu
    apply Fin.ext
    have ht := pick_spec t
    have hu := pick_spec u
    have hval : (pick t).val = (pick u).val := congrArg Fin.val htu
    omega
  let S : Finset (Fin n) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 7)).image pick
  have hS_card : S.card = 7 := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hpick_inj]
    simp
  have hS_subset : S ⊆ E := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
    rcases hi with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact hpick_mem t
  have hcard_le : S.card ≤ E.card := Finset.card_le_card hS_subset
  have hE_eq :
      E.card = ((internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)).card := by
    rfl
  omega

[Minimal counterexample size bound]
  
  
  
  
  
  \textit{Source: half-formal.qmd, Lemma \texttt{\#lem-bound}.}
  If there is a counterexample at some \(n\geq6\) divisible by \(3\),
  then there is an \(n_0\in\mathcal S\) at which a counterexample exists.
nodes.proof_tex:
\leanok
  Choose the least size \(n\geq6\), divisible by \(3\), at which a
  counterexample \(c\) exists.  If \(n=6\), there is nothing to prove.
  Otherwise \(n\geq9\).

  Every internal coordinate lies between \(1\) and \(3\) by
  Theorem~\ref{thm:interior_positive}.  There cannot be three consecutive
  internal coordinates equal to \(1\): deleting such a block would give a
  live all-rank wait of size \(n-3\).  Minimality would force the shortened
  hand to be standard, and
  Theorem~\ref{thm:delete_three_standard} would then force \(c\) itself to
  be standard, a contradiction.

  Let \(E\) be the set of internal coordinates whose multiplicity is not
  \(1\), and put \(k=|E|\).  Positivity and the upper bound \(3\) imply
  that every member of \(E\) contributes at least \(1\) to
  \(\sum_{i=2}^{n-1}(c_i-1)\).  Hence
  \[
    k\leq\sum_{i=2}^{n-1}(c_i-1)
      =(n+4-c_1-c_n)-(n-2)
      =6-c_1-c_n\leq6.
  \]
  The \(k\) exceptional positions divide the remaining \(1\)'s into at
  most \(k+1\) blocks.  Since no block has length \(3\), each has length
  at most \(2\), and therefore
  \[
    n-2\leq k+2(k+1)=3k+2\leq20.
  \]
  Thus \(n\leq22\).  Combining \(6\leq n\), \(3\mid n\), and
  \(n\leq22\) yields \(n\in\{6,9,12,15,18,21\}\), as required.

theorem counterexample_size_bound
    (h : ∃ n, 6 ≤ n ∧ 3 ∣ n ∧ CounterexampleAt n) :
    ∃ n₀, n₀ ∈ smallSizes ∧ CounterexampleAt n₀ := by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun m => 6 ≤ m ∧ 3 ∣ m ∧ CounterexampleAt m
  have hP : ∃ m, P m := by
    simpa [P] using h
  let n := Nat.find hP
  have hnP : P n := Nat.find_spec hP
  have hminimal : ∀ {m : ℕ}, m < n → ¬ P m := by
    intro m hm
    exact Nat.find_min hP hm
  rcases hnP with ⟨hn6, hdiv, hcounter⟩
  rcases hcounter with ⟨c, hc, hnonstd⟩
  by_cases hn22 : n ≤ 22
  · exact ⟨n, smallSizes_mem_of_admissible_le_22 hn6 hdiv hn22, ⟨c, hc, hnonstd⟩⟩
  · have hn24 : 24 ≤ n := by
      have hn23 : 23 ≤ n := by omega
      rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
      omega
    have hn9 : 9 ≤ n := by omega
    have hno_three :
        ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j + 3 < n →
          ¬ (∀ r : Fin n, j ≤ r.val → r.val < j + 3 → c r = 1) := by
      intro j hj_left hj_right hsingle
      let hj : j + 3 ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt hj_right
      let d : Counts (n - 3) := deleteThree c j hj
      have hd_live : LiveWait d := by
        dsimp [d, hj]
        exact delete_three_live_wait hn9 hdiv c hc j hj_left hj_right hsingle
      by_cases hd_std : d = standard (n - 3)
      · have hc_std : c = standard n := by
          exact (delete_three_standard_iff c j hj_left hj_right hsingle).mpr
            (by simpa [d, hj] using hd_std)
        exact hnonstd hc_std
      · have hdiv_del : 3 ∣ n - 3 := by
          rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
          exact ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
        have hPdel : P (n - 3) := by
          refine ⟨by omega, hdiv_del, ?_⟩
          exact ⟨d, hd_live, hd_std⟩
        exact (hminimal (by omega)) hPdel
    have hpos :
        ∀ i ∈ internalIndices n, 1 ≤ c i := by
      intro i hi
      have hi' := mem_internalIndices.mp hi
      exact interior_positive hn6 hdiv hc hi'.1 hi'.2
    have hexcess_le : (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) ≤ 6 :=
      internal_excess_le_six hn6 hdiv hc
    have hcard_le :
        ((internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)).card ≤
          (internalIndices n).sum (fun i => c i - 1) :=
      exception_card_le_internal_excess hpos
    have hseven :
        7 ≤ ((internalIndices n).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 1)).card :=
      seven_le_exception_card_of_no_three hn24 hno_three
    omega

theorem no_counterexample_of_small
    (hsmall : ∀ n ∈ smallSizes, ¬ CounterexampleAt n) :
    ∀ n, 6 ≤ n → 3 ∣ n → ¬ CounterexampleAt n := by
  intro n hn6 hdiv hcounter
  rcases counterexample_size_bound ⟨n, hn6, hdiv, hcounter⟩ with
    ⟨n₀, hn₀_small, hn₀_counter⟩
  exact hsmall n₀ hn₀_small hn₀_counter
